title: Transcript core contract
description: The fields every provider's transcripts carry, with the same names and meanings. Each `transcripts/<source>.jsonl` row also validates against its provider's own strict schema; this one allows extra fields so provider-specific data passes through. Code written against these fields alone works on every provider.

transcript_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the transcript. Primary key; annotations and moments join on it.

source.description: The provider this transcript came from; matches the file name. Pattern `tutoring_provider_<letter>`.

batch.description: Partner delivery this transcript came from.

has_video.description: Whether the partner provided a recording of the session. Recordings are not released.

turns.description: Ordered dialogue turns. `turn_number` is the order authority.

turn_number.description: 1-indexed position in the transcript. Annotations refer to turns by this number.

role.description: The speaker. `Unattributed` is speech assigned to neither participant; not every provider uses it.

text.description: What the speaker said. De-identified with surrogate names; names that are part of problem content (e.g. a word problem) may be left unchanged.

start_seconds.description: Offset of the turn's start, in seconds. Where zero falls is provider-specific; some providers also give `end_seconds`.

session.description: Surrogate identifiers for the session and its participants. Providers add their own session fields alongside these.

session_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's session ID.

tutor_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's tutor ID. Stable across this tutor's sessions. Not shared across providers.

student_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's student ID. Stable across this student's sessions. Not shared across providers. Joins to the provider's assessments file.
